# Security illustrations

Generated on 2026-10-13 with the built-in image generation tool. Four original decorative 3D illustrations for IT Global. Generated as RGBA PNG files with transparent backgrounds. No existing brand illustrations or logos were used as references.

## Files

- `backup.png`: backup copies, two storage drives and a confirmation tile.
- `access.png`: access control, a user keycard and padlock.
- `connection.png`: protected connections, two endpoints joined through a lock.
- `audit.png`: activity audit, a checklist and magnifying glass.

## Exact generation prompts

### backup

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an original premium 3D security icon for the IT Global website, to be placed in the lower part of a charcoal #34343c card. A single cohesive isolated still-life icon, no UI card and no background. Square composition, centered and fully framed with generous 14% transparent margins. Consistent tactile high-end studio 3D render: soft matte ivory ceramic, muted sage green, terracotta orange accent, brushed silver metal. Slightly elevated three-quarter view, rounded modern forms, soft studio light from upper left, polished but not glossy plastic, subtle object self-shadow only. Actual transparent alpha background, no backdrop or floor, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no arrow, no branded marks. Subject: Two compact rounded silver storage drives gently offset, one slightly behind the other, and a small terracotta copy/document tile bearing a simple raised ivory check. The pair clearly conveys a separate backup copy. Deliberately simple large readable shapes.
